title: Geometric realization of normalized cofinal support
statement: Let k be a finite-field datum of characteristic p [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], let $\ell\ne p$ be prime, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type k-schemes with fixed compactification c [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. There exists a CofinalSupport t with all the ordinary, derived, factorization, section and evaluation normalizations of [def-pur-etale-system-cofinal-data]. Its projection data additionally satisfy: every $q_a$ is invertible and $q_{a\circ b}$ is the successive coefficient-projection path, under the canonical balanced scalar associators [lem-pur-etale-system-coefficient-projection]. This is solely the geometric realization; it asserts no formula involving a chosen compact-support right adjoint.

source.place: Construction 4.1 and paragraph preceding Lemma 4.10, printed pp. 21--23; finite-block generalization already in parent proof steps 1--3.

proof.text: Choose a simultaneous geometric projection theory T and its block and factor evaluation diagrams using etaleCofinalBlockFactorization. Extract finite-level coefficient invertibility from etaleSystemCoefficientProjection. A private jointly-reflecting level-evaluation proof, together with the generic projection evaluation equation, proves invertibility for this same T. The public generic coefficient coherence theorem gives composition for T. No arbitrary existential projection-theory witness is assumed to have literal sectionwise open-extension comparisons.

For each coefficient tower and subsequence choose the local normalized selected extensions on X and Y. Apply the chosen theory’s block construction to these extensions, obtaining repetition, the two factor comparisons, and their three explicit evaluation diagrams. Each choice is constrained by its universal property and its section/unit/counit normalizations.

The ordinary cofinal restriction compositor is Mathlib SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp followed by pushforwardCongr. Its coefficient map equality is eqToHom_map and eqToHom_trans; both maps are identity on sections. Define h by whiskering the X factor comparison, inverse coefficient projection, R.kappa, and inverse Y factor comparison, with the canonical associators. Functoriality and inverse-isomorphism cancellation prove the required normalization directly in the derived system category.

Apply the fixed-data evaluation lemma to h and its proved normalization, using the coefficient projection equation and the explicit block/factor evaluation diagrams. Assemble CofinalSupport, retaining coefficient invertibility and composition for T.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleCofinalSupport_realization
    (k : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) (hl : l.Prime) (hlp : l ≠ k.p)
    (X Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k.k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.left] [QuasiCompact f.left]
    (c : Compactification f.left) :
    ∃ t : CofinalSupport c l,
      (∀ (B C : Coefficients.{u} l) (a : B.rings ⟶ C.rings),
        IsIso (t.projection.q a)) ∧
      (∀ (B C D : Coefficients.{u} l) (a : B.rings ⟶ C.rings) (b : C.rings ⟶ D.rings),
        t.projection.q (a ≫ b) = t.projection.path a b)
